Furthermore, the reverse DCF indicates that today's price already implies a 4.1% earnings growth rate, surpassing the 2.0% growth assumed in the base case [E45]. Operational efficiency is chronically depressed, demonstrated by a 10-year median return on equity of just 7% and a last-year median ROE of 4% [E25, E28]. Cash generation has also deteriorated sharply, with operating cash flow plunging to negative ₹ 23 Cr and free cash flow dropping to negative ₹ 21 Cr in Mar 2026, leading to a distressed cash conversion of -1.77x [E33, E34, E35].
